subject: executor: fix data race in the join.(*hashJoinSpillHelper).generateSpilledValidJoinKey() (#60061)
summary: Diff vs first parent is limited to making `hashJoinSpillHelper.spilledValidRowNum` an `atomic.Uint64` and switching the only write sites to `Add/Store` plus the stats read site to `Load` (`pkg/executor/join/hash_join_spill_helper.go`, `pkg/executor/join/hash_join_v2.go`). This removes a clear concurrent write/write race when multiple spill workers call `generateSpilledValidJoinKey` in parallel, without affecting join semantics/privileges/txn/session behavior (counter is only used for spill stats sizing). No later changes touching `spilledValidRowNum` were found up to `upstream/master`.
